text.title: The Lost Suitcase
paragraphs: Last summer, Carla flew from São Paulo to Miami for a conference. The flight was long, but she slept for six hours and felt great when the plane landed.

At the airport, she went to the [[baggage claim]] and waited. She saw a lot of suitcases, but not hers. After forty minutes, she went to the airline desk. A woman took her name and gave her a [[form]].
Carla had a big problem: her dress for the conference was in the suitcase! So she took a taxi to a mall, bought a new dress and a toothbrush, and [[spent]] two hundred dollars.
The next morning, the phone [[rang]]. It was the airline: "We found your suitcase! It went to Chicago [[by mistake]]." They brought it to her hotel that afternoon.
Carla [[wore]] her new dress at the conference anyway. Now she always packs a change of clothes in her [[carry-on bag]].

baggage claim.pt: esteira de bagagens, retirada de bagagem

spent.note: to spend → spent = gastar (dinheiro) ou passar (tempo)

grammar.title: Past simple: verbos irregulares
explanation: Muitos verbos comuns são irregulares: no passado, eles não ganham -ed, mas mudam de forma. Por exemplo: go → went, have → had, take → took, see → saw.

Não existe uma regra, então é preciso memorizar. A boa notícia: os mais usados são poucos, e aparecem o tempo todo em séries e conversas. Alguns deste texto: fly → flew, sleep → slept, feel → felt, give → gave, buy → bought, find → found, bring → brought, wear → wore.
Uma dica: buy, bring e think terminam todos em -ought no passado: bought, brought, thought.
Como nos verbos regulares, a forma é a mesma para todas as pessoas: I went, she went, they went.
Nas frases negativas e nas perguntas, usamos did e o verbo volta para a forma básica: She didn't go, Did she go? Isso é o tema da lição 6.

examples.en: The suitcase went to Chicago by mistake.
examples.pt: A mala foi para Chicago por engano.

exercises.explanation: Ela voou de São Paulo para Miami: "Carla flew from São Paulo to Miami". Foi a mala que foi para Chicago.

exercises.prompt: Por que a Carla comprou um vestido novo?
options: Porque o vestido da conferência estava na mala
Porque ela não gostava do vestido dela
Porque a loja estava em promoção
exercises.explanation: O texto diz: "her dress for the conference was in the suitcase!"

exercises.statement: The airline found the suitcase in Miami.
exercises.explanation: Falso: a mala foi para Chicago por engano ("It went to Chicago by mistake").

exercises.explanation: Buy é irregular: buy → bought (como brought e thought).

exercises.explanation: Find é irregular: find → found. Verbos irregulares nunca ganham -ed.
